headline: India's minister confirms 29 Indian seafarers safe across TWO vessels -- Louise 1 (27) and Liberia-flagged VLCC Arzanah'
dek: [VERIFIED FACT] A small boat attached two limpet mines to the hull of Panama-flagged Suezmax tanker Louise 1 in the Strait of Hormuz on Oct 29 (~25nm NE of Khasab), causing an engine-room fire and temporarily disabling the vessel; crew safe, no environmental impact, fire extinguished, vessel…
sources: Reuters (three maritime security sources) via gCaptain; UKMTO advisory; Indian Union Minister for Ports, Shipping and Waterways Sarbananda Sonowal (X statement) via Times of India
fault_line: Who mines the strait -- and can a small boat still walk up to a tanker under a US escort regime? Attribution (Tehran vs unattributed) vs the fact of a new weapon working for the first time since February.
